title: lablab niger var. rhomboideus
intro: Lablab niger var. rhomboideus, commonly known as Indian bean or Egyptian kidney bean, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lablab niger var. rhomboideus include treating various health conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
